repositories.name: FastH3 Preview
repositories.description: 4-step MiniMax-H3 — video with a matching soundtrack

paragraphs: FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-4-step-Preview-v1-VSA-DataFree is a data-free DMD2 + VSA-H3 distillation of MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3, the 33B dual-modality DiT that emits a video and its synchronized soundtrack from one denoising pass. The student keeps the teacher's architecture exactly and only replaces transformer/, so it is a drop-in for the same diffusers modular pipeline — but it needs four DiT forwards instead of thirty.

The teacher Space compiles its 50 repeated transformer blocks with AoTI, which removes a near-constant 0.5 s/step of kernel-launch and epilogue overhead. Over 30 steps that is worth 15 s; over four forwards it is 2 s of a 110 s request. Not worth the loader and its keying risk, so this Space runs eager.

Likewise VSA (Video Sparse Attention): the student was trained with 64-token tiles at 90% sparsity and carries the attn.togatecompress gate parameters, but the kernel is sm100a (GB200) and the ZeroGPU pool is sm120. The card documents dense as the default and this Space runs dense — diffusers logs the 50 gate tensors as unexpected keys and drops them, so they cost disk but no VRAM. Attention is cuDNN's fused kernel (nativecudnn), 10–20% faster than the SDPA default and needing nothing installed.

repositories.name: Samudra 2
repositories.description: Roll a neural ocean emulator forward against GFDL-OM4

paragraphs: Interactive rollouts of M2LInES/Samudra2, an autoregressive neural emulator of the global ocean.

The 1° checkpoint is a ConvNeXt U-Net (84 M parameters) that maps the ocean state at two consecutive 5-day snapshots — potential temperature, salinity, zonal/meridional velocity over 19 depth levels, plus sea-surface height (77 fields → 154 channels) — together with surface forcing (wind stress, heat flux and its day-of-year anomaly) to the next two 5-day snapshots. One model step therefore advances the ocean by 10 days, and steps are chained autoregressively.

repositories.name: Boeing 747 — Fable 5 vs Fable 5.1
repositories.description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: Two procedurally generated Boeing 747s, side by side, with the cameras locked together. Drag, orbit or zoom on either half and the other follows exactly, so every comparison is made from the same angle, the same distance and the same lens.

Both aircraft are modelled at true scale (70.7 m long, 64 m span) in the same construction frame, so the two views are matched on the camera's offset from each aircraft's own centre rather than on absolute position.

The most visible difference is the fuselage: the 5.1 model derives its cross-section from Boeing's published cabin drawing, a single superellipse 6.50 m wide at main-deck floor level with the crown 4.93 m above it, rather than a cylinder with an upper-deck bulge added on.

repositories.name: MiniMax H3 Turbo LoRA - I2V with Audio
repositories.description: Fast video & audio generation with 4-step Turbo LoRA

paragraphs: Joint high-fidelity video and synchronized audio generation using unquantized bfloat16 weights with a 4-step Turbo LoRA.

Distributed ZeroGPU Architecture: MiniMax-H3 (196 GiB bf16) exceeds Hugging Face's 150 GB per-Space disk limit. To avoid quality-degrading NVFP4/FP8 quantization, the pipeline is split across two coordinated Spaces: - Conditioner Space: qwen3vl-conditioner (Text/Vision encoding, 62 GiB bf16) - Denoising Space (This Space): Transformer & VAEs (72 GiB bf16)
features: ⚡ 4-Step Turbo LoRA: Default 6 sampling steps (down from 28) using larryvrh/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora folded directly into weights at startup.
🚀 AoTI Compilation: 50 transformer blocks accelerated via PyTorch AoTI (multimodalart/minimax-h3-aoti), saving 0.5s/step overhead.
🎯 Full Precision (bf16): Zero quantization artifacts; outputs full 24 fps video with matching stereo AAC soundtrack.
💻 Custom Studio Interface: Built on Gradio Server & FastAPI with server-side keyframe crop/canvas fitting.

whatItDoes.text: Joint high-fidelity video and synchronized audio generation using unquantized bfloat16 weights with a 4-step Turbo LoRA.
